inspectionReference.usage: Visual enlargement only. All recorded coordinates refer to the 1672x941 source, never to this enlargement.

coordinateSystem.pathFormat: SVG path data in the original source coordinate system

sourcePolicy.rgbPixels: Preserve original source RGB for every extracted feature. Do not regenerate a face, iris, brow, lip or earring.
sourcePolicy.alpha: Intersect every extraction mask with the original source alpha.
sourcePolicy.underpaint: A separate blank-face underpaint is supplied by the parent workflow. It is not a replacement for the visible original features.
sourcePolicy.mouthInterior: Separate source pending. Do not claim visible closed-mouth pixels contain a complete mouth interior, teeth or tongue.
sourcePolicy.hiddenPixels: Hidden sclera, hidden iris perimeter and skin behind hair are not restored by these coordinate masks.
sourcePolicy.accuracy: Hand-traced visual mask plan. Boundaries need composite inspection after extraction, especially eyelid edges and the lip seam.

maskConventions.fillRule: nonzero unless a feature explicitly declares evenodd
maskConventions.resampling: Do not resize individual layers before extraction.
maskConventions.featherMeaning: Proposed alpha-edge antialiasing only, not RGB recoloring or a new facial feature. Existing source-alpha boundary remains authoritative.

innerFace.usage: Bare-face boundary used as a hole in the hair extraction; front hair stays above this boundary. Original forehead/cheek RGB is retained in the face source.

neck.usage: Exclusion from hair, not a claim that the hidden full neck is painted. Collar/torso retain their original occlusion.

hair.strategy: Single original-pixel core hair layer before optional later subdivision
notes: The outside silhouette comes from source alpha; the broad path only isolates the head from jacket/body.
Keep crown, side waves and visible ends together initially. Do not add excessive tiny strands or repaint the accepted hairstyle.
The inner-face/ear/neck holes prevent skin pixels from being assigned to the hair layer. Inspect overlap seams after extraction.

sclera.source: Original visible white only; iris pixels must not remain burned into the sclera layer

eyeL.notes: Keep original lash tips and lid shading. A closed eyelid needs separate skin underpaint; squeezing the iris/whole socket is not a finished blink rig.

sclera.source: Original visible white only; iris pixels must not remain burned into the sclera layer

eyeR.notes: Screen-left is character-right. Do not mirror the original iris, highlight or eyelashes to make the other eye.

browL.source: Original brow hairs and their local alpha edge

browR.source: Original brow hairs; preserve the portion naturally covered by the side fringe

upperLip.source: Original upper-lip RGB, including the original smile contour

lowerLip.source: Original lower-lip RGB and highlight; no replacement lip texture

seamGuide.usage: Registration guide only; never render this path as an artificial dark stroke

notes: The two lips share the observed closed-mouth seam; masks need a composite seam check before rigging.
Do not expose empty alpha between lips and call it an authored mouth cavity.
Do not rotate a separately generated mouth onto this face; keep the approved original pixels.

earringL.source: Original stud, connector and pearl, retaining highlight

earringR.source: Original stud, connector and pearl, retaining highlight

occlusionPlan: Keep neck behind face/chin and torso collar.
Keep ear skin behind the hair waves that cover its upper edge.
Place original visible sclera behind original iris/pupil; place lid/lash edges over both.
Place brows above face, with naturally overlapping fringe above brows where source pixels require it.
Keep earring studs attached to their ear-side pivot; preserve the existing hair/pearl overlap.
Place separate mouth interior behind both original lips only after the actual interior source is supplied.
notVerified: Extracted masks have not yet been composited and inspected at neutral pose.
